description: Source code for Type 1 font character map support in FreeType, including standard, expert, custom, and Unicode encodings.

methods.name: t1_cmap_std_init
methods.description: Initializes standard or expert encoding character maps.

methods.name: t1_cmap_std_done
methods.description: Finalizes standard or expert encoding character maps.

methods.name: t1_cmap_std_char_index
methods.description: Retrieves glyph index for a given character code in standard/expert encoding.

methods.name: t1_cmap_std_char_next
methods.description: Finds next character code in standard/expert encoding.

methods.name: t1_cmap_custom_char_index
methods.description: Retrieves glyph index for a character code in custom encoding.

methods.name: t1_cmap_custom_char_next
methods.description: Finds next character code in custom encoding.

methods.name: t1_cmap_unicode_char_index
methods.description: Retrieves glyph index for a Unicode character code.
